source.zh: 填写源图纸、页码、版本日期及实际项目身份
source.en: Enter source drawings, sheet references, revision date and actual project identity

tax_note.zh: 未另计销售税/使用税；当地税费及报价包含方式待核实。
tax_note.en: Sales/use tax has not been added. Confirm local taxes and what supplier quotes include.

price_note.zh: 填写单价来源、日期、是否已询价和报价包含项
price_note.en: Enter rate sources, dates, quote status and inclusions

label.zh: 地坪（还需补齐其他基础项）
label.en: Slab (add all other required foundation components)

basis.zh: 填写尺寸、单位和计量依据；不得遗漏条基、柱基、挡土墙等
basis.en: Enter dimensions/units/basis; add strip footings, pads, retaining walls and other applicable components

price_basis.zh: 填写运输泵送及税费是否包含
price_basis.en: State delivery, pumping and tax inclusions

label.zh: 填写工序并增加所需任务
label.en: Enter activity and add required tasks

basis.zh: 综合人工包含工资及雇主用工负担。机械土方和泵车已含各自操作员，不在此重复；管理利润另计。每工日按8小时，检查和养护会增加日历工期。
basis.en: Labor includes wages and employer burden. Excavation and pump subcontract allowances include their operators; do not count them again here. Overall overhead/profit is separate. Worker-days use 8 hours; inspections and curing extend calendar duration.

label.zh: 填写其他材料机械分包暂列项

basis.zh: 说明包含项以及是否含操作员，避免重复人工
basis.en: Describe inclusions and operators to avoid double-counting labor

assumptions.zh: 填写本项目实际假设和未确认尺寸
assumptions.en: Enter project-specific assumptions and unconfirmed dimensions

verification.zh: 填写订货报价前需要确认的事项
verification.en: Enter items to verify before quotation or ordering

exclusions.zh: 填写实际不包含的施工范围
